title: feat(plugin-grid,core): the Import Wizard names the column a lookup cell was scoped by; a scope no read could filter by says so
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDqyPrPQvkURDXnUDgkyFWB)_

Fixes #36794 (PR-2 of 2; PR-1 #37567 landed the spec reason and the importer)

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 导入向导在预检和完成页上，对“查找值属于另一个父记录”的情况显示专门的提示，例如 `"Design review" was found, but not under Project "Gemini"`。提示会用标签说出限定它的列和本行填的值，11 种界面语言都已翻译。
- 补上契约审核提出的一个漏洞：如果 `dependsOn` 指向一个引擎无法筛选的字段（比如公式），限定查询一次都没跑成。这种情况以前会被误报成“在别的父记录下”，现在照旧报“找不到记录”，提示语改为说明无法在这个范围内查找，需要给 `dependsOn` 换一列。
- 只影响导入失败行的显示文字和一种配置错误时的错误码，成功导入不受影响，没有新增可写的元数据键。整张 PR 可以直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- **Import Wizard** (`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx`): `formatDryRunError` gains `case 'reference_out_of_scope'`, rendered from the cell error's structured `scope`. Each entry is named by the importing object's field label (its api-name when it has none) with the cell the row gave it, joined in the order the server sent them by the pack's own separator (`grid.import.scopeSeparator`: `、` in ja and zh, `، ` in ar; review N3). The Wizard keys on the code and `scope` only and never parses the server sentence; a cell error with no `scope` falls through to the server's own sentence (already in the caller's locale), the same path an unknown code takes. `scope` is carried onto `ImportResult.errors` by both the synchronous import mapping and `jobResultToImportResult`, so the completion screen renders the same text as the dry-run panel. New keys `grid.import.referenceOutOfScope`, `grid.import.scopeEntry` and `grid.import.scopeSeparator` are in the Wizard's default dictionary and in all 11 locales under `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/`.
- **Review nit 2, a scope no read could filter by** (`packages/core/src/utils/import-runner.ts`, `import-coerce.ts`): the resolver records whether any scoped candidate read ran to an answer, and whether a read was refused by the engine's filter seam for the scope: `isScopeFilterRefusal`, the declared `code: 'INVALID_FIELD'` naming a scope field in `fields`, read off the refusal like `isScopeFieldDenial`, never its message. Only when no read answered and such a refusal was seen (the `dependsOn` `param` names a target field the engine cannot filter by, such as a `formula`) does it return `RefMatch.scopeUnqueryable`. A lookup whose reads are all refused for any other reason (no read grant on the target, a driver fault) keeps the plain miss and the plain sentence (contract review S1, 7204641031). That cell keeps `reference_not_found`, with no unscoped probe and no `scope`, and gets its own catalog sentence `import_reference_scope_unqueryable`, whose remedy names the target field the `dependsOn` entry filters by ("point that dependsOn entry at a stored field", review N1) (`packages/spec/src/system/validation-message.ts`, all four platform locales). **Chosen: the runtime answer, no lint.** A lint refusing such a `dependsOn` would refuse metadata that publishes today, which is a narrowing that needs its own card. Before this PR that cell answered `reference_out_of_scope` once the unscoped probe found the value, which claimed a fact the import never checked.
- **Review nit 1**: `ImportRowResultSchema.errors` describe (`packages/spec/src/api/export.zod.ts`) and the runner's `ImportRowResult.errors` jsdoc now say a `reference_out_of_scope` element carries `scope`. Regenerated `content/docs/references/api/export.mdx`.
- **Review nit 4**: `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx` now says `scope` names the row's own scoping columns and the cells the row gave them, not the parent's columns.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx`, scoped-lookup section: a `dependsOn` `param` naming a formula cannot scope the lookup, and the cell answers `reference_not_found` with the could-not-look-up sentence; any other refusal keeps the plain sentence.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/core`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch. `Metadata-protocol: none`: no key enters `packages/spec/authorable-surface/*.json`, because `check:generated` moved only the references page. The new catalog key is message vocabulary, the same class as PR-1's `import_reference_out_of_scope`, which its claim also read as `none`. `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: a new catalog key a deployment can override, and a wire answer that only becomes more precise for a case no released version answered `reference_out_of_scope` for.

## Tests

- **Review nit 3, a real engine and the real field guard** (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/import-reference-out-of-scope.dogfood.test.ts`): a booted stack with the real `SecurityPlugin`, ObjectQL, SQL driver and the REST import door, plus a fixture member whose permission set hides `oos_task.project`. The guard is shown live first: the member's filter on that field gets 403, the admin's gets 200. The pins:
  - Admin, a task of another project: `reference_out_of_scope` with `scope: [{ field: 'project', value: 'Gemini' }]`. The in-scope row resolves and stores the id. A value nobody has: `reference_not_found` with no `scope`.
  - Member, the same rows: `reference_not_found`, plain sentence, no `scope`, including the row whose task really is under its own project.
  - A `dependsOn` whose `param` is a formula: `reference_not_found` with the `import_reference_scope_unqueryable` sentence.
  - None of these reads the guard's reason across a package as a string. Each answer comes from the real seam.
- Ablation (dogfood): with the `isScopeFieldDenial` branch disabled, the member pin goes red. With the `scopeUnqueryable` assignment disabled, the formula pin goes red (2 failed / 2 passed). Restored: 4 passed.
- `packages/core/src/utils/import-runner-reference-master-scope.test.ts`: a new pin in which every scoped read is refused `INVALID_FIELD` naming the scope field. It answers `reference_not_found` with the new sentence, no `scope`, and no unscoped probe. Two pins for S1: every read refused `PERMISSION_DENIED` naming no field, and every read refused `INVALID_FIELD` naming a field outside the scope; both answer the plain sentence.
- `packages/spec/src/system/validation-message.test.ts`: every locale of `import_reference_scope_unqueryable` interpolates `{{value}}` and `{{scope}}` and names `dependsOn`; the English render.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/importDryRun.test.ts`: the new case names the scope column by its label and the row's cell; a multi-column scope names every column (one without a label by api-name), joined by the pack's separator; it is never rendered as "no matching record"; with no `scope`, the server sentence is shown minus the api-name prefix. `importAsyncPath.test.ts`: `jobResultToImportResult` carries `scope` onto the error.

<details><summary>Local readings (tree 8b99fd1b, on main fbcfdfbb; round 2 head f9dcf30a: core master-scope 19 passed, spec validation-message 45 passed, dogfood out-of-scope 4 passed, ui i18n + plugin-grid 428 files / 4822 passed, plugin-grid type-check and core tsc green)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix`: 1 stale (`content/docs/references/**`, the `errors` describe), green after; nothing under `packages/spec/authorable-surface/` moved.
- `typecheck` core and spec: green. `type-check` `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/i18n` (deps built): green. `lint` plugin-grid: 0 errors.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/plugin-grid/`: two i18n census pins moved with the new keys and were updated in this PR (`de-quote-pairing-3876`, 133 → 135 paired spans; `untranslated-identity-4376`, `grid.import.scopeEntry` allowlisted as a format string). After that: i18n 111 files / 2028 passed; plugin-grid files green (the first run's only 3 failures were those two i18n pins).
- spec `src/system/` + `src/data/mapping.test.ts`: 80 files / 2841 passed. core `src/utils/`: 51 files / 1356 passed.
- dogfood `import-reference-out-of-scope` + `import-reference-exposure`: 2 files / 15 passed (core built from this tree).
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: VERDICT clean exit 0 (main, #37676, #37667, #37422).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The unfilterable-scope cell keeps the `reference_not_found` code, so the Wizard shows its generic "No matching record" text there. The precise sentence reaches API callers in the cell error's `message`. That case is an authoring mistake that a Wizard user cannot fix, and a code of its own would be a new `FieldErrorCode` member, which needs its own contract review. Left as it is.

## Verification

Read first: `formatDryRunError` in `ImportWizard.tsx` (`case 'reference_out_of_scope'`), the resolver's `lookup` in `import-runner.ts` (`asked`, `scopeUnqueryable`), and `referenceNotFound` in `import-coerce.ts`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/importDryRun.test.ts -t "reference_out_of_scope"` runs 4 tests, all green.
